name: cross-platform-photorealistic-selfie-fidelity
privacy: The user-provided comparison images are not copied into the repository; this file records only generalized visual invariants and failure patterns.

source_profile.canvas: vertical mirror selfie, close framing, subject fills most of the frame
material: restrained natural sheen rather than a smooth satin or plastic surface
natural tension folds and small irregular wrinkles
visibility_and_pose: main facial features remain clearly visible
phone is beside the face rather than covering it
hair frames the face without covering the eyes
head is not strongly tilted downward
pose remains an informal close mirror selfie rather than a centered catalog portrait
light_and_color: no unsupported strong blue color cast

gpt_like_output: subtle textile grain and roughness are lost
composition becomes more centered and standardized
grok_like_output: some folds remain but the fabric surface is still over-smoothed
close candid framing drifts toward a conventional portrait
midjourney_like_output: face becomes partially obscured by hair, phone, or downward head pose
deep V wrapped top changes into a conventional high-neck or crew-neck top
neutral lighting drifts toward a strong cool-blue cast

required_skill_invariants: Material must be represented as a profile of grain, roughness, gloss, thickness, folds, and stretch when visible.
Generic realism or high-detail wording must not replace observable material attributes.
Garment or object geometry must preserve neckline, overlap, openings, waistline, and hardware.
Face or key-subject visibility must preserve the actual occlusion relationship rather than always forcing or ignoring occlusion.
Phone, hair, hand, and prop positions must be described relative to facial features when they affect visibility.
Subject scale, crop, pose, and informal-versus-standard portrait character must remain stable.
Overall color temperature must not drift without image evidence.
Flat illustrations and graphic posters must not receive invented photorealistic microtexture.

The final Markdown contains only six platform-specific blocks: GPT, Grok, and Midjourney in Chinese and English; the internal visual fact source is not emitted as a generic or natural-language prompt.
pass_criteria: All six platform-language variants retain every applicable high-drift invariant.
GPT and Grok variants use concrete material attributes instead of only realistic fabric wording.
Midjourney variants place high-drift positive facts early and use --no only for directly conflicting outcomes.
Positive description defines the correct material and geometry; negative terms do not replace it.
Final validation checks material, structure, visibility, composition, and light/color separately.
No generic, original, model-agnostic, or natural-language prompt section appears in the final Markdown.
